title: ChatGPT can now learn your writing style to sound more like you, here is how
key_facts: OpenAI says ChatGPT Work can now learn a user's writing style and apply it to future writing.
It picks up favourite phrases, sign-offs and capitalisation habits.
It learns from emails, messages and files in connected tools such as Gmail, Google Drive, Slack and SharePoint.
Set-up is under Settings > Personalization > Writing style.
It applies across ChatGPT Work on web and mobile.
Available on the web for all paid plans with access to ChatGPT Work.
quote_evidence: Connect the tools you use every day, like Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, and SharePoint, and ChatGPT Work will learn your writing style from your emails, messages, and files.
The new writing style feature is available on the web for all paid plans that have access to ChatGPT Work.
why_it_matters_hint: Work users can get drafts in their own voice, at the price of giving ChatGPT access to their emails and files.
event_date: Announced on X, around 14-15 Oct 2026 (date not stated)
notes: Based on OpenAI's X post as reported by Digit. Exact announcement date not stated.
